answer: A single member can vouch for only one sparrow per epoch, so forging identities requires real capital at risk plus a limited social endorsement. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit that acts as an anchor of trust, and every new identity needs an existing member to whisper a vouch for it. Attacker cost scales with both slashed deposits and exhaustion of scarce vouches, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
